name: DC committed memory snapshot
description: Latest Memory % Committed Bytes In Use per selected DC in the requested range, with configurable percentage colors. This is committed-memory utilization, not physical RAM usage.
kql:
Perf
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where ObjectName == 'Memory' and CounterName == '% Committed Bytes In Use'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, CounterValue) by Computer
| project Computer, CommittedMemoryPercent = round(CounterValue, 2), LastObservation = TimeGenerated
| order by CommittedMemoryPercent desc
